title: Antigen-Presenting Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts Modulate Tumor Microimmunity.
snippet: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are key regulators of tumor progression, immune modulation, and therapeutic resistance within the tumor microenvironment. Advances in single-cell and spatial profiling have revealed substantial heterogeneity among CAF populations, challenging the traditional view of CAFs as a uniformly tumor-promoting stromal population....
